crossRefs.note: The king said to Esther at the banquet of wine, “What is your petition? It shall be granted you. What is your request?…
Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.

people.name: Esther
people.line: Jewish queen of Persia; saved her people from genocide.

translations.web: The king said again to Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine, “What is your petition, queen Esther? It shall be granted you. What is your request? Even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.”
translations.bsb: and as they drank their wine on that second day, the king asked once more, “Queen Esther, what is your petition? It will be given to you. What is your request? Even up to half the kingdom, it will be fulfilled.”
translations.kjv: And the king said again unto Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine, What is thy petition, queen Esther? and it shall be granted thee: and what is thy request? and it shall be performed, even to the half of the kingdom.
translations.asv: And the king said again unto Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine, What is thy petition, queen Esther? and it shall be granted thee: and what is thy request? even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.
